name: Pope Clement XI
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1700 to 1721
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 23 November 1700 to his death in March 1721.

checks.lead: Pope Clement XI (Latin: Clemens XI; Italian: Clemente XI; Albanian: Klementi XI; 23 July 1649 – 19 March 1721), born Giovanni Francesco Albani, was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 23 November 1700 to his death in March 1721.
